responsibility: Implements GCC’s <stdckdint.h> support for the ISO C23 checked integer arithmetic interface by defining the feature-test version macro and the `ckd_add`, `ckd_sub`, and `ckd_mul` macros as wrappers around GCC’s overflow-checking builtins. Its responsibility is to expose a standard source-level API for performing integer operations that both store the computed result through a caller-provided pointer and report overflow as `_Bool`, while deferring the actual overflow semantics and type-aware code generation to `__builtin_add_overflow`, `__builtin_sub_overflow`, and `__builtin_mul_overflow`; it also leaves room for a host C library to extend or replace parts of the header via `include_next`.
